taxonomy.name: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications
taxonomy.attribution: Category identifiers and titles: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026, OWASP Gen AI Security Project, CC-BY-SA-4.0. Project-specific relationships are additions, not OWASP endorsements. Source terms are recorded here; project redistribution licensing remains separately unresolved.

mappings.rationale: A tool parameter syntactically reaches eval/exec in the same function. This is relevant to reviewing unintended code execution, but the syntax alone does not establish an adversarial execution path.
mappings.required_verification: Confirm tool registration, parameter provenance, validation, executable reachability, intended behavior and sandbox privileges. Parameter rebinding or trusted inputs may invalidate an attacker-controlled interpretation.

native_rule.remediation: Replace tool-argument evaluation with bounded, explicitly allowed operations.
native_rule.title: Direct tool parameter reference passed to eval or exec

mappings.rationale: Nonliteral content in a system-message declaration is a review point for instruction provenance. It becomes relevant to goal hijacking only if lower-trust content can influence actual agent instructions or decisions.
mappings.required_verification: Trace content origin, template construction, actual model use, agent goal/action effects and intervening controls. Fixed templates and trusted configuration may be ordinary behavior. This rule does not establish memory persistence or poisoning.

native_rule.boundary: Literal role/content shape or resolved SystemMessage; no model use or poisoning proof.
native_rule.title: Nonliteral content in declared system message

mappings.rationale: Agent-like call or routing syntax can identify code worth inspecting when locating communication boundaries. It is inventory context, not a test of communication security.
mappings.required_verification: Establish that separate agents actually communicate and inspect transport, message integrity, identity, authorization and semantic validation. Naming alone establishes none of these and does not establish Agent2Agent protocol support.

native_rule.boundary: Receiver spelling and argument shape; not actual agent invocation or safe routing.
native_rule.title: Agent-like call or routing syntax
